IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hinkle, B. Sullivan, Sump, Pettigrew, Ross, Kretz, Warnick, Hailey, Ahern and Upthegrove

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions for the processing of meat products for human consumption.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tax exemptions for meat processing; adding a newsection to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the retail saleof slaughtering, breaking, and/or processing perishable meat products,if the meat product is not owned by the person engaged in theslaughtering, breaking, and/or processing and the finished product isa perishable meat product for human consumption.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof slaughtering, breaking, and/or processing perishable meat products,if the meat product is not owned by the person engaged in theslaughtering, breaking, and/or processing and the finished product is p. 1 HB 2040a perishable meat product for human consumption.
